findings.location: docs/product/architecture/ADR-NAV-POLISH-006.md Decision and Consequences; architecture.md L7 negative case (lines 1298, 2168); feature_canzan_theme.rs:3284 glyph_only >= 1
findings.obligation: The standing check for the exemption is the L7 case that a wordless button inside .app-shell but outside the rail keeps 3:1. A negative row owes a named in-product control and page that the walk really reads and that fails a plausible wrong exemption; otherwise the exemption can widen with nothing failing.
findings.remediation: Design: name the control and page that anchors the negative row and the probe floor after nav-collapse leaves it. Candidates: .lane-menu-trigger on a board page (it already holds a 1px --cz-muted border, so it passes at 3:1 and is a true negative), or the open modal-close. State how the walk classifies it, since glyph (svg or aria-hidden) is false for it today, and redefine the floor as wordless-and-outside-the-rail, not glyph-only. Acceptance designer then implements; the floor must fail when every control leaves the reading.

observations.text: O1 INSPECTIVE: citations verified. board_columns.html:44 renders .lane-menu-trigger in every column section, outside the rail aside; foundry.2f9e0cb1.css:1802-1816 gives it border: 1px solid var(--cz-muted) over --cz-surface; the walk enumerates button inside .app-shell (feature_canzan_theme.rs:2337-2339) so the trigger is read, with a non-empty border, and meets 3:1 by the css:1809-1815 measured 5.52 and 6.08. Its text node is an ellipsis, so glyph is false and the old glyph-only floor could not count it, as the ADR says. Fallback .modal-close: board.html:14 puts #modal-root in the board page, which extends app_shell, so it is inside .app-shell.

O2 INSPECTIVE: ADR-007 closes finding 3. The floor becomes a reading (at least one outside-rail control read for 3:1 on every board page the law runs on), anchored on a true negative that passes by its own border; an exemption widened past the rail empties that reading and turns it red. Alternatives rejected with reasons (per-control exception, markup change to fit a test, all-controls count that rail controls satisfy alone, dropping the floor). Collapsing a_word_names_it (shipped :3191, still word-and-glyph keyed) to inTheNav alone is recorded as the acceptance designer's work. Residue stated: nothing refuses a control being placed inside the rail; the floor makes it visible. Not a defect.
